summary: Comprehensive testing of Budget App MVP completed successfully. All core features working: transaction management, budget creation, savings goals, analytics, and settings. Backend APIs 100% functional, frontend responsive and intuitive.

design_issues.issue: Minor timeout during page reload test - theme functionality works but reload test had timing issue

passed_tests: All 22 backend API endpoints (100% success rate)
Dashboard page loads with monthly summary (balance, income, expenses, savings rate)
Add transaction form works for both expense and income types with category selection
Budget creation and limit tracking functional
Savings goals creation with progress tracking and add money functionality
Analytics page displays charts (income vs expenses trend, spending breakdown)
Settings page - view categories and create custom category works
Theme toggle (dark/light mode) works on desktop and mobile
Navigation between all pages works smoothly
Mobile responsiveness - all features work on mobile devices
Integration between frontend and backend - data syncs correctly
Transaction filtering by month and type
Dashboard real-time updates after transactions/budgets/goals changes

success_percentage.frontend: 98% (minor timeout issue in theme persistence test)
